subject_scope: Bundled toy JSON restoration with a two-record fixture.
method: tools/demo_loop.py observe() executes the selected toy variant and checks the retained raw outcome.
units_or_anchors: Boolean predicate; exactly one asserted outcome for this instance.
environment_ref: Local temporary directory under this Python process
positive_control: restore_checked accepts intact backup and rejects corrupted backup.
negative_control: restore_noop emits success text but fails both required outcome predicates.
resource_limit: Two tiny fixture executions; no network.
freshness_rule: Any change to toy implementation variant, evaluator or fixture requires rerun.
